review: Independent retrospective inspection of the complete retained Phase 6 PNG set
method: Each of the 82 listed images was opened through view_image and visually inspected. No geometry-only approval or inference from unseen images.
scope: Historical Phase 6 images; final guide has subsequent graph wording, arrow and disabled-control contrast corrections. This report does not certify current rendered output.

findings.description: At normal 420px width, the introduction heading wraps Map the game before changing / it, leaving a one-word heading tail.
findings.disposition: Owned residual polish concern; no content loss. Parent retains it after the three global correction-cycle ceiling.

findings.description: Desktop fullscreen before Run leaves a substantial empty terminal band between the command and reply placeholder. Approximate observed gap grows from 108px at 1280x720 to 503px at 1920x1080; native and fallback pairs share it.
findings.disposition: Owned residual layout concern against the compact empty-state objective; no controls or content lost. Parent retains it after the three global correction-cycle ceiling.

considered_but_rejected.candidate: Mobile technical file paths split inside words
considered_but_rejected.reason: Complete paths remain contained and readable; technical metadata containment differs from avoidable prose/heading wrapping.

considered_but_rejected.candidate: Scrolled state captures hide the top command under navigation
considered_but_rejected.reason: These captures begin partway into the panel; paired top/fullscreen captures show the complete header. This is a capture limitation, not proof of document content loss.

considered_but_rejected.candidate: Normal desktop short file previews leave spare space beside the game
considered_but_rejected.reason: The naturally shorter preview sits beside a taller comparison arena without artificial blank preview expansion or lost reading order.
